pr_body:
Fixes #41380

I'd like to do some research about (g)PTP and therefore need some support for the PTP capabilities of some MCUs. One point to start is porting the STM32 Ethernet HAL driver to the new API.
The big goal is implementing an API proposal for PPS (Pulse per second) input/output and to connect the PTP clock to other peripherals like TIM2.

Any help (especially testing) is welcome.

issue_context.title: stm32h7: Ethernet: Migrate driver to the new eth HAL api
issue_context.body:
**Is your enhancement proposal related to a problem? Please describe.**
A new eth cube hal api is being pushed in STM32Cube (https://github.com/STMicroelectronics/stm32h7xx_hal_driver/pull/16).
It is first deployed to H7 series and will be then be progressively extended to other STM32 series.
This new HAL provides significant performance benefits and additional features (cf related github PR)
To use it, existing STM32 ethernet HAL driver should be reworked.

I'm raising this issue to synchronize efforts on this task.

EDIT: A STM32H7Cube package has been proposed that includes examples using the new HAL API. It's available here:
https://github.com/STMicroelectronics/STM32CubeH7/pull/195

review_comments: Please remove this change, as it doesn't seem required.

A new Kconfig option to enable the change progressively would be preferable.
It would allow to easily compare both implementations tests results on similar code base.
Also, it would feel less risky to merge either default n or default y (with the possibility, if issues are reported, to disable the time issues are fixed).
